name: Worm that Walks Sorcerer
body:
Worm that Walks Sorcerer
CR 13

XP 25,600
Male human worm that walks sorcerer 12
NE Medium vermin (augmented humanoid, mythos)
Init +5; Senses blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+4 Dex, +2 insight)
hp 104 (12d6+60); fast healing 13
Fort +3; Ref +4; Will +10
Defensive Abilities worm that walks traits; DR 15/—; Immune critical hits, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +9 (1d4–1 plus grab)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (15 ft. with melee touch attacks)
Special Attacks discorporate, grab (Large), squirming embrace (3d6), tenacious
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12th; ranged touch +10):

8/day—acidic ray (1d6+6 acid)

Spells Known (CL 12th; melee touch +5; ranged touch +10):

5th (4/day)—cloudkill (DC 20), feeblemind (DC 20)
4th (6/day)—black tentacles, boneshatter (DC 19), obsidian flow (DC 19)
3rd (7/day)—ash storm, eruptive pustules (DC 18), excruciating deformation (DC 18), tongues
2nd (7/day)—blur, boiling blood (DC 17), boneshaker (DC 17), fire breath (DC 17), see invisibility
1st (8/day)—burning hands (DC 16), cause fear (DC 16), charm person (DC 16), color spray (DC 16), ear-piercing scream (DC 16), enlarge person (DC 16)
0 (at will)—acid splash, bleed (DC 15), dancing lights, daze (DC 15), jolt, mage hand, ray of frost, spark (DC 15), touch of fatigue (DC 15)

Bloodline aberrant

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 18, Con 21, Int 18, Wis 6, Cha 21
Base Atk +6; CMB +5 (+13 grapple); CMD 23
Feats Arcane Blast, Arcane Shield, Combat Casting B, Diehard B, Disruptive Spell, Eschew Materials B, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lifeless Gaze
Skills Bluff +22, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (history) +19, Knowledge (local) +19, Knowledge (nobility) +16, Knowledge (planes) +16, Perception +18, Perform (act) +16, Perform (oratory) +12, Sense Motive +6, Stealth +12; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception, +8 Sense Motive, +8 Stealth
Languages Abyssal, Common, Elven, High Boros, Protean
SQ bloodline arcana (polymorph spells +50% duration), long limbs

ABOUT

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure NPC Gear (+4 leather armor, cloak of resistance +4, staff of charming)

Although this robed wizard stands and moves like a man, his body is a writhing mass of squirming, slippery worms.
